created_prompt: Can you produce a strategy to develop a business over a three year time-frame? The business is founded around a popular video channel showing how to cook quick healthy meals. It has 1.2m followers. The woman running this channel works four days a week and has limited time and budget, but want to grow their online following and publish a cook book - either traditional method or self-publishing. Considering all of these factors, craft a sophisticated but concrete and practical three-year strategy to achieve this person's goals.
